subject.title: fix(agents): repair orphaned tool_use pairs on compaction prune path

question: Should compaction use the same aborted assistant tool-call drop policy as provider-send sanitization, accepting small context loss to avoid strict-provider transcript rejection?
rationale: The code repair is narrow and appears correct, but the durable behavior choice is whether compaction should drop aborted tool-call turns or synthesize an error result for the summarizer, which affects retained session context.

options.title: Accept drop policy
options.body: Merge this PR after exact-head refresh because dropping aborted tool-call turns matches existing send-path sanitization and avoids malformed strict-provider transcripts.

options.title: Require synthetic recovery
options.body: Ask for a revised design that preserves an explicit synthetic or metadata-marked result when maintainers prefer summarizer-visible interrupted-turn context.

options.title: Pause for broader recovery
options.body: Keep this PR paused and track a larger session-recovery design if neither context loss nor synthetic results is acceptable yet.

recommendation.title: Accept drop policy
recommendation.body: Merge this PR after exact-head refresh because dropping aborted tool-call turns matches existing send-path sanitization and avoids malformed strict-provider transcripts.
